LEVER (a), s500p perf round 37 (RUNTIME-ONLY).  Float -> decimal text by EXACT INTEGER arithmetic.

PROFILE LINE THAT FOUND IT (s500p Step 0, main 209e7533): 0613-Heronian-triangles, sb-impl::flonum-to-digits 28.2 % total (called from %p-str-eq-slow 38.9 % -- `sprintf("%.0f", $hero) eq $hero` stringifies a double per call), sb-kernel:two-arg-gcd 3.3 % (sprintf %f's RATIONAL scale), bignum-truncate 3.9 %.  0823-Mandelbrot-set: two-arg-gcd 3.0 %, truncate1 2.9 %, bignum-truncate 3.7 %.

MECHANISM: stringify-value's %.15g fixed branch called (format nil "~,VF" digits v) -- SBCL's ~F runs the shortest-digits dragon with bignums -- and %p-decimal-exponent / %p-exponential-15 / sprintf-format-float-f computed with RATIONALs whose every product normalises through GCD.

FIX: a double is exactly M*2^E, so its value scaled by 10^K is a ratio of two integers and C's round-half-even on the exact value is CL ROUND of that ratio: %p-scaled-round (a shift + mask when the divisor is a power of two), %p-float-digits (15 significant digits + the exponent of the ROUNDED value, the log only a first guess, corrected exactly), %p-float-g15-string (the %.15g text), an integral-double-below-1e15 arm that prints the integer directly, and sprintf %f through %p-scaled-round.  %p-decimal-exponent keeps its name and contract (%g uses it).  *p-pow10* = 10^0..10^359.

SEMANTIC NOTE: ~F rounds a 15th-digit TIE half-AWAY; perl (glibc) rounds it half-EVEN on the exact value.  26.72662353515625 printed 26.7266235351563 under PCL, 26.7266235351562 under perl; 118 fields of an 11,565-double random table moved from wrong to perl's text, 0 moved away (scratch/s500p/rnd.* in the s500p worktree; the 36 remaining differences are `0 + $v` printing an NV where perl's IV-please prints an integer -- #2450's family, pre-existing, unchanged).
